title: Honest Torch
description:
Honest Torch
This powerful torch by honest is the right tool for heating the elev8r vaporizer and is also ideal for heating dab rigs.
On the rear of the Honest Torch is the butane release valve and just under the nozzle is the trigger to spark the fuel. There is also a safety switch on the side that prevents the trigger from being pulled.
This torch does not have a wide base like most but does not feel like it would tip over that easily anyway. On the box this comes in the picture shows this with a base but is not included.
Included
1 x Honest Torch
